rules.name: lal-uat-04-recon-cfs-check
rules.sql: WITH filled AS ( SELECT l.trade_id, l.active_lots FROM opera.latest_active_lot l WHERE l.tenant_id = :tenant AND l.business_unit = 'CFS' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM parity_work.change_lal_uat_02_fill_fill_all_bus_20261119160510 b WHERE b.tenant_id = l.tenant_id AND b.business_unit = l.business_unit AND b.trade_id = l.trade_id) ) SELECT count(*) AS filled_trades, count(*) FILTER (WHERE active_lots <> 0) AS filled_nonzero_lots, (SELECT count(*) FROM opera.latest_active_lot WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND business_unit = 'CFS') AS cache_trades FROM filled

expect.reason: the fill added CFS trades (1,177,828 expected)

rules.sql: WITH old_cache AS ( SELECT DISTINCT b.trade_id FROM parity_work.change_lal_uat_02_fill_fill_all_bus_20261119160510 b WHERE b.tenant_id = :tenant AND b.business_unit = 'CFS' ), ptr AS ( SELECT p.view_type, p.settlement_date, p.published_run_id FROM opera.recon_snapshot_pointer p WHERE p.tenant_id = :tenant AND p.business_unit = 'CFS' AND p.settlement_date = (SELECT max(p2.settlement_date) FROM opera.recon_snapshot_pointer p2 WHERE p2.tenant_id = p.tenant_id AND p2.business_unit = p.business_unit AND p2.view_type = p.view_type) ), snap AS ( SELECT 'SETTLE_PRICING' AS view_type, s.run_id, coalesce(s.source_trade_id, regexp_replace(s.trade_id, '-CFS$', '')) AS trade FROM opera.recon_settle_snapshot s JOIN ptr p ON p.view_type = 'SETTLE_PRICING' AND s.run_id = p.published_run_id WHERE s.tenant_id = :tenant AND s.business_unit = 'CFS' UNION ALL SELECT 'SETTLE_ACTUAL_PRICING', s.run_id, coalesce(s.source_trade_id, regexp_replace(s.trade_id, '-CFS$', '')) FROM opera.recon_actual_snapshot s JOIN ptr p ON p.view_type = 'SETTLE_ACTUAL_PRICING' AND s.run_id = p.published_run_id WHERE s.tenant_id = :tenant AND s.business_unit = 'CFS' UNION ALL SELECT 'TRADERS_PRICING', s.run_id, coalesce(s.source_trade_id, regexp_replace(s.trade_id, '-CFS$', '')) FROM opera.recon_traders_snapshot s JOIN ptr p ON p.view_type = 'TRADERS_PRICING' AND s.run_id = p.published_run_id WHERE s.tenant_id = :tenant AND s.business_unit = 'CFS' ), per_view AS ( SELECT x.view_type, x.trade, count(*) AS n FROM snap x GROUP BY x.view_type, x.trade ) SELECT p.view_type, p.settlement_date, rr.resolved_value_date, rr.row_count AS run_row_count, rr.updated_timestamp::text AS run_updated, coalesce(sum(v.n), 0) AS snapshot_rows, count(v.trade) AS snapshot_trades, count(v.trade) FILTER (WHERE o.trade_id IS NULL) AS from_filled, count(v.trade) FILTER (WHERE o.trade_id IS NOT NULL) AS from_old_cache, CASE WHEN count(v.trade) FILTER (WHERE o.trade_id IS NULL) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS built_after_fill FROM ptr p JOIN opera.recon_refresh_run rr ON rr.uuid = p.published_run_id LEFT JOIN per_view v ON v.view_type = p.view_type LEFT JOIN old_cache o ON o.trade_id = v.trade GROUP BY p.view_type, p.settlement_date, rr.resolved_value_date, rr.row_count, rr.updated_timestamp ORDER BY p.view_type

expect.reason: CFS has at least one published recon snapshot
every published CFS snapshot contains trades the fill added (FAIL before the rebuild is expected)
